page.layout: One page of text, a title page: centred lines from top to bottom, an engraving with a banner below the middle, then the imprint centred at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Pro duabus Ecclesiarum in Gallia Protestantium Synodis Nationalibus;
Altera Alensone, anno cIↄ IᴐC XXXVII : altera verò Carentone, anno cIↄ IᴐC XLV habitis:
[engraving: a seated man beneath a tree, birds flying above, banner reading EXSPECTANDO]

page.notes: The engraving shows a seated figure under a tree with birds in flight and a landscape; the banner below it reads EXSPECTANDO. The R in pencil at the left margin is handwriting and is omitted. The date is printed in old Roman numeral form (cIↄ = M, IᴐC = DC), rendered here as in the scan. The imprint line "Sumptibus Joannis Ravesteynii" is partly cut off at the left edge of the scan.
